## Change

<!-- Objectively describe what was changed. -->

## Reason

<!-- Explain why the change was necessary. -->

## Scope

- [ ] The change is within the scope of the task.
- [ ] No unrelated features were included.
- [ ] No unnecessary refactorings were included.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit tests executed.
- [ ] Relevant integration tests executed.
- [ ] Smoke test executed when applicable.
- [ ] Lint executed.
- [ ] Relevant CI validated.

## Regression

- [ ] When applicable, there is a test reproducing the behavior that failed before the fix.
- [ ] The test actually validates the expected behavior.

## Architecture

- [ ] Existing responsibilities were preserved.
- [ ] No unnecessary abstraction was created.
- [ ] Contract/architecture changes have justification.

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation was updated when necessary.
- [ ] No redundant documentation was created.

## Final review

- [ ] `git diff` reviewed.
- [ ] `git status` reviewed.
- [ ] There are no unrelated files or changes.
- [ ] The commit message adequately explains the change and, when necessary, its reason.
